status: author-reviewed logical design baseline, stakeholder approval/implementation/verification pending

scope.initial: Early lifecycle engineering before commissioning or developing hardware

authority_rules: L08 owns accepted-baseline custody, common identifiers/schema vocabulary and transfer checks.
Each domain owner controls meaning of its persistent records. Shared records are referenced, not copied into competing authorities.
Generated artifacts identify source contract and transformation revisions. Handwritten mission behavior is a separate controlled artifact.
Changes require identified proposals and human disposition. Accepted changes create successor revisions and preserve old evidence.
Transfer acceptance, chain completeness, model applicability, evidence verdict and facility authorization are distinct.
Quantities preserve dimensions, units, sign, frame, conditions and uncertainty. Time distinguishes numerical time, runtime, sample/receipt time and physical loop delay.
Not-applicable fields require rationale. Unknowns and missing criteria prevent contradictory supported/verified/readiness claims.

components.name: Engineering guidance and knowledge
components.observable_obligation: Retrieve sourced guidance, templates and worked examples with applicability and limitations. Publish reviewed knowledge revisions without asserting standards compliance.
components.authority_limit: Human engineering, review and facility decisions remain explicit. Record completeness and transfer acceptance establish no technical truth or safety approval.

allocated_operations.observable_obligation: The framework shall provide requirement and traceability templates, worked EPS examples, and a guided reference workflow that covers writing criteria, linking evidence, and interpreting gaps.
The framework shall retain a source-linked catalogue of requirement derivation and verification methods, standards, and activity templates with applicability, tailoring rationale, and limitations.

components.name: Needs, requirements and decision governance
components.observable_obligation: Retain verifiable requirements and rationale. Retrieve both trace directions, identify change impact, record human disposition and RAM coverage, and keep critical/stale evidence visible.
components.authority_limit: Human engineering, review and facility decisions remain explicit. Record completeness and transfer acceptance establish no technical truth or safety approval.

allocated_operations.observable_obligation: The framework shall retain each requirement as an identified record with source need, parent, rationale, observable quantities or conditions and applicable units, owner, verification method, criterion, and resolution status.
The framework shall retrieve applicable links from needs and requirements to design decisions, model inputs, verification criteria and results, and retrieve the reverse paths.
The framework shall identify the requirements, EPS and non-EPS allocations, BOMs, models, software definitions, procedures, and evidence affected by a designated change.
The framework shall issue a successor baseline for an accepted change that retains its request and failed-gate context and marks affected evidence as regenerated, stale, or unresolved.
The framework shall report missing, rejected, stale, out-of-domain, failed, and unresolved evidence with its affected claim, criticality rationale, owner and disposition.

The framework shall record how sourced component power and thermal characteristics and subsystem behavior become EPS or component requirement parameters, including units, uncertainties, allowable ranges and criterion decisions.
The framework shall identify the RAM variables and failure assumptions applicable to designated EPS and spacecraft requirements and report their verification-method coverage and gaps.

components.name: Architecture and service contracts
components.observable_obligation: Maintain configurable generic and case EPS representations and discipline mappings. Specify shared hardware/model/flight/ground services, check both target profiles and command/recovery flow, and retain target compatibility/resource evidence.
components.authority_limit: Human engineering, review and facility decisions remain explicit. Record completeness and transfer acceptance establish no technical truth or safety approval.

allocated_operations.observable_obligation: The framework shall provide a configurable generic EPS representation covering requirements, functions, logical and physical elements, interfaces, modes and states, with case-specific parameter and extension records.

The framework shall exchange identified EPS component and design data with declared electrical, thermal, EMC and CAD analysis tools and retain model mappings, applicable outputs and unsupported checks.

The framework shall retain revision-linked EPS command, telemetry, event and parameter definitions with identifiers, types, units, ranges and encodings mapped to hardware, functional software and ground dictionaries.

The framework shall produce or coordinate checked mappings of the EPS software contract to declared cFS software-bus and F-Prime typed-connection profiles and identify behavior and implementation gaps.

The framework shall specify and check EPS command preconditions, order, expected effects, rejection and failure behavior, mode transitions and recovery responsibilities across EPS, telemetry, fault-management and safe-mode functions.

The framework shall retain a versioned OBC, operating-system, flight-framework and toolchain configuration with compatibility evidence and processor, memory, timing and power budget evidence for EPS functions.

components.name: Component and lifecycle characterization
components.observable_obligation: Bind sourced component data to exact occurrences. Generate candidate BOMs, scoped cost arithmetic and justified RAM representations with explicit missing information.
components.authority_limit: Human engineering, review and facility decisions remain explicit. Record completeness and transfer acceptance establish no technical truth or safety approval.

allocated_operations.observable_obligation: The framework shall generate and revise a candidate-specific BOM from identified physical design items with assembly, quantities, part identifiers, variant and selection status, and source revision.

The framework shall derive a revision-linked financial estimate from the BOM and declared additional cost categories while retaining price source, date, currency, quantity, estimate basis, uncertainty and missing data.

The framework shall generate a declared RAM analysis representation from identified functions, components and failure dependencies with traceable transformation rules and sourced or missing reliability data.

components.name: Scenario and analysis orchestration
components.observable_obligation: Compose controlled time-dependent mission and battery models, execute or coordinate virtual scenarios, compare EPS options and policies on a common basis, record fidelity/runtime/delay evidence and support independent replay.
components.authority_limit: Human engineering, review and facility decisions remain explicit. Record completeness and transfer acceptance establish no technical truth or safety approval.

allocated_operations.observable_obligation: The framework shall provide controlled instructions and dependencies to reconstruct and execute a designated analysis and compare its raw outputs using declared result-specific rules and tolerances.

The framework shall produce a comparison of designated EPS architectures using a common requirement, assumption, evidence and criterion basis with feasibility status, raw measures, uncertainty and decision rationale.

The framework shall compose time-dependent subsystem demand, duty cycles, schedules and mode transitions with orbit, attitude, irradiance, eclipse, thermal conditions and EPS supply and protection behavior.

The framework shall execute or coordinate declared virtual EPS and component verification scenarios for dynamic loads, supply changes, protection events, rare faults, and controller electrical and timing constraints.

The framework shall integrate identified battery electrical, thermal and degradation models with mission loads and retain the states, health and lifetime outputs, assumptions and uncertainty supported by each model.
The framework shall record the selected model fidelity, execution environment, time step, measured or estimated runtime and interface delays for each declared SIL or HIL interaction profile.

The framework shall compare designated charging and power-management policies under declared load, thermal, health, electrical and timing conditions with safety constraints and policy-specific outcome evidence.

components.name: Model credibility and observation reconciliation
components.observable_obligation: Qualify model intended use and observation interpretation. Preserve raw data/masks and timing rules, compare expected and observed behavior, and propose identified calibration updates and alternative diagnoses.
components.authority_limit: Human engineering, review and facility decisions remain explicit. Record completeness and transfer acceptance establish no technical truth or safety approval.

allocated_operations.observable_obligation: The framework shall associate each analytical verification claim with the model intended use, tested validity domain, calibration and validation evidence, uncertainty and acceptable prediction-error rule.
The framework shall use supplied measurements to create an identified calibration or parameter-update record with data quality, prior and revised parameters, residuals and affected analyses.

The framework shall compare time-correlated EPS telemetry with modeled expected behavior while retaining operating mode, model validity, degradation and sensor uncertainty, and alternative fault explanations.
The framework shall record the time base, sampling and synchronization rules and known measurement, calculation and output delays for applied stimuli, responses and telemetry.
The framework shall check expected telemetry channels, units, timestamps, completeness and sensor validity conditions and preserve raw samples, invalid values and processing masks.

components.name: Verification specification and safety
components.observable_obligation: Retain method-specific verification specifications, technician-readable proposals and safety declarations. Block incomplete physical-readiness claims and report scoped admissibility with residual verification obligations.
components.authority_limit: Human engineering, review and facility decisions remain explicit. Record completeness and transfer acceptance establish no technical truth or safety approval.

allocated_operations.observable_obligation: The framework shall retain each EPS or component verification activity with requirement, method, DUT baseline, applicable quantities or observable conditions, inputs, expected response, criterion, evidence variables and status. An inapplicable field shall retain its rationale.

The framework shall produce a technician-readable verification proposal that specifies conditions, equipment and fixture identities, DUT connections, stimulus sequence, observations and evidence-generation procedure.

The framework shall include hazards, battery and electronics operating limits, fault-injection envelope, isolation, abort conditions and responsible safety-review status in each proposed physical verification activity.

components.name: Information and configuration authority
components.observable_obligation: Control identified retrievable baselines, semantic transfer checking, result provenance and recoverable evidence custody. Preserve prior accepted content and rejected-transfer findings.
components.authority_limit: Human engineering, review and facility decisions remain explicit. Record completeness and transfer acceptance establish no technical truth or safety approval.

allocated_operations.observable_obligation: The framework shall retain identified, retrievable baselines of engineering records, case configuration, and evidence with revision history and distinct identities for accepted successors.

The framework shall check transferred identifiers, structure, quantities, units, polarity, time bases, interface meanings, and provenance against a declared contract and retain explicit rejection findings.

The framework shall associate each result with its producer, method, requirement and decision, design and hardware configuration, software and model versions, parameter set, input data, environment, and raw output.

components.name: Case workspace and technical review
components.observable_obligation: Produce controlled readable views and review packages. Declare minimum adoption conditions, record common-protocol observations and apply the same identified core to two predefined cases with visible changes and outcomes.
components.authority_limit: Human engineering, review and facility decisions remain explicit. Record completeness and transfer acceptance establish no technical truth or safety approval.

allocated_operations.observable_obligation: The framework shall produce filtered context, structure, interface and selected-design views from controlled EPS records with identifiers, units, legends and links to the represented baseline.
The framework shall assemble the designated requirement, decision, design, evidence, assumptions, uncertainty, validity limits, findings and dispositions into a baseline-linked review package.

The framework shall declare prerequisites, resource footprint, licenses, dependencies and learning instructions for its minimum workflow and record adoption, adaptation, change, reproduction and direct-cost observations under one evaluation protocol.
The framework shall apply an identified common core to two predefined contrasting EPS cases using declared parameters, mappings and extensions and retain case outcomes and any core changes.

requirements.title: Requirement record
requirements.text: The framework shall retain each requirement as an identified record with source need, parent, rationale, observable quantities or conditions and applicable units, owner, verification method, criterion, and resolution status.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: A complete fixture round-trips these fields. An absent criterion is reported as unresolved and cannot acquire a verified label.
requirements.field_applicability_rule: A not-applicable field requires a rationale, as directed by the author review.

requirements.title: Learning and templates
requirements.text: The framework shall provide requirement and traceability templates, worked EPS examples, and a guided reference workflow that covers writing criteria, linking evidence, and interpreting gaps.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Inspect the learning package and demonstrate the workflow from a declared clean start. Measure learner effort and errors without imposing an unagreed time limit.

requirements.title: Method applicability
requirements.text: The framework shall retain a source-linked catalogue of requirement derivation and verification methods, standards, and activity templates with applicability, tailoring rationale, and limitations.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: For subsystem and component fixtures retrieve the chosen method and its source, conditions, tailoring decision, and excluded alternatives. A catalogue entry does not assert standards compliance.

requirements.title: Bidirectional trace retrieval
requirements.text: The framework shall retrieve applicable links from needs and requirements to design decisions, model inputs, verification criteria and results, and retrieve the reverse paths.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Compare both query directions with the fixture relation set. Missing, ambiguous and stale endpoints remain visible.

requirements.title: Change impact
requirements.text: The framework shall identify the requirements, EPS and non-EPS allocations, BOMs, models, software definitions, procedures, and evidence affected by a designated change.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Use seeded cross-subsystem and component changes. Compare the returned impact set and unresolved coverage with an adjudicated reference.

requirements.title: Change disposition
requirements.text: The framework shall issue a successor baseline for an accepted change that retains its request and failed-gate context and marks affected evidence as regenerated, stale, or unresolved.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Exercise a failed verification gate followed by correction. Preserve the prior baseline and prevent stale results from appearing current.

requirements.title: Controlled baselines
requirements.text: The framework shall retain identified, retrievable baselines of engineering records, case configuration, and evidence with revision history and distinct identities for accepted successors.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Reconstruct two revisions after a change and compare their manifests and contents. Attempted overwrite cannot erase the retained prior baseline.

requirements.title: Semantic transfers
requirements.text: The framework shall check transferred identifiers, structure, quantities, units, polarity, time bases, interface meanings, and provenance against a declared contract and retain explicit rejection findings.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Inject unit, sign, identifier and time-base mismatches. Reject incompatible transfers without replacing controlled content. Record unsupported or lossy mappings.

requirements.title: Result provenance
requirements.text: The framework shall associate each result with its producer, method, requirement and decision, design and hardware configuration, software and model versions, parameter set, input data, environment, and raw output.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Trace an analytical and a supplied measurement result to every applicable configuration item. An unknown identity remains a gap and blocks a contradictory validity claim.

requirements.title: Independent replay
requirements.text: The framework shall provide controlled instructions and dependencies to reconstruct and execute a designated analysis and compare its raw outputs using declared result-specific rules and tolerances.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: An independent participant replays a baseline from a clean declared environment. Retain logs, seeds when relevant, failures and comparison verdicts. Tolerances are fixed before replay.

requirements.title: Evidence and discrepancy status
requirements.text: The framework shall report missing, rejected, stale, out-of-domain, failed, and unresolved evidence with its affected claim, criticality rationale, owner and disposition.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Seed each status including a critical finding. A claim affected by unresolved critical evidence cannot receive an unqualified supported or verified status.

requirements.title: Candidate BOM
requirements.text: The framework shall generate and revise a candidate-specific BOM from identified physical design items with assembly, quantities, part identifiers, variant and selection status, and source revision.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Compare two alternative assemblies and one component substitution with a reference BOM. Candidate alternatives remain distinct. Missing part data is reported.

requirements.title: Financial estimate
requirements.text: The framework shall derive a revision-linked financial estimate from the BOM and declared additional cost categories while retaining price source, date, currency, quantity, estimate basis, uncertainty and missing data.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Recalculate a sourced-price fixture after a quantity and part change. Match reference arithmetic and preserve unknown costs. Do not import historical project costs as new framework measurements.

requirements.title: EPS candidate comparison
requirements.text: The framework shall produce a comparison of designated EPS architectures using a common requirement, assumption, evidence and criterion basis with feasibility status, raw measures, uncertainty and decision rationale.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Compare candidates with a failing requirement and incomplete evidence. Keep feasibility and unknown status separate from ranking. Any preference weights are declared before results.

requirements.title: Reusable EPS representation
requirements.text: The framework shall provide a configurable generic EPS representation covering requirements, functions, logical and physical elements, interfaces, modes and states, with case-specific parameter and extension records.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Instantiate the representation in two contrasting cases and trace a requirement through function, allocation, interface and analysis. An extension retains its relation to the generic core.

requirements.title: Dynamic mission composition
requirements.text: The framework shall compose time-dependent subsystem demand, duty cycles, schedules and mode transitions with orbit, attitude, irradiance, eclipse, thermal conditions and EPS supply and protection behavior.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Use a fixture whose average budget passes while a coupled load and illumination event creates a transient shortage. Inspect inputs, interactions and event timing against a reference calculation.

requirements.title: Requirement parameter derivation
requirements.text: The framework shall record how sourced component power and thermal characteristics and subsystem behavior become EPS or component requirement parameters, including units, uncertainties, allowable ranges and criterion decisions.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Derive a fixture allocation from datasheet and supplied measurement inputs using a declared method. Preserve assumptions and flag unsupported ranges and undecided pass/fail values.

requirements.title: Discipline model integration
requirements.text: The framework shall exchange identified EPS component and design data with declared electrical, thermal, EMC and CAD analysis tools and retain model mappings, applicable outputs and unsupported checks.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Every electrical, thermal, EMC and CAD exchange profile required by the frozen minimum shall complete its reference request/result exchange and declared identity, quantity, unit, meaning and revision checks. Retain unsupported mappings and development gaps. A missing required profile remains not verified or undetermined and cannot pass V18. A narrower minimum requires a reviewed scope disposition before evaluation.

requirements.title: Early verification scenarios
requirements.text: The framework shall execute or coordinate declared virtual EPS and component verification scenarios for dynamic loads, supply changes, protection events, rare faults, and controller electrical and timing constraints.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Retain stimulus, conditions, expected response, outputs and status for nominal and failure fixtures. Unsupported behavior and physical validation needs are explicit, including COTS evidence gaps.

requirements.title: Battery model coupling
requirements.text: The framework shall integrate identified battery electrical, thermal and degradation models with mission loads and retain the states, health and lifetime outputs, assumptions and uncertainty supported by each model.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Replay fresh and aged battery fixtures under different load and temperature profiles. Verify coupling and provenance. Missing aging mechanisms and latent-state uncertainty remain visible.

requirements.title: Intended-use credibility
requirements.text: The framework shall associate each analytical verification claim with the model intended use, tested validity domain, calibration and validation evidence, uncertainty and acceptable prediction-error rule.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Exercise an in-domain and an extrapolated claim. Separate calibration from validation data where available. Flag untested domains and absent error limits. Prediction accuracy limits require prior agreement.

requirements.title: Model update workflow
requirements.text: The framework shall use supplied measurements to create an identified calibration or parameter-update record with data quality, prior and revised parameters, residuals and affected analyses.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Apply a measurement fixture, compare the declared calibration result with a reference, retain both parameter revisions, and flag analyses affected by drift or update.

requirements.title: Fidelity and execution contract
requirements.text: The framework shall record the selected model fidelity, execution environment, time step, measured or estimated runtime and interface delays for each declared SIL or HIL interaction profile.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Profile a declared executable model and replay timestamped input/output fixtures. Real-time suitability remains unresolved until the applicable hardware and deadline are verified.

requirements.title: Controller policy assessment
requirements.text: The framework shall compare designated charging and power-management policies under declared load, thermal, health, electrical and timing conditions with safety constraints and policy-specific outcome evidence.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Replay a baseline and a changed policy against the same fixture conditions. A model prediction cannot be labeled a demonstrated hardware improvement. Retain pending SIL, HIL or hardware evidence.

requirements.title: Anomaly assessment
requirements.text: The framework shall compare time-correlated EPS telemetry with modeled expected behavior while retaining operating mode, model validity, degradation and sensor uncertainty, and alternative fault explanations.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Use nominal, degrading, noisy and injected-fault fixtures. Retain residuals and diagnoses with TP, FP and FN against an expert reference. No pre-threshold detection capability is presumed.

requirements.title: RAM requirement coverage
requirements.text: The framework shall identify the RAM variables and failure assumptions applicable to designated EPS and spacecraft requirements and report their verification-method coverage and gaps.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Compare the declared RAM variable and requirement set with a reference. Report analysis, inspection, demonstration or test rationale without forcing every claim to use analysis.

requirements.title: RAM model generation
requirements.text: The framework shall generate a declared RAM analysis representation from identified functions, components and failure dependencies with traceable transformation rules and sourced or missing reliability data.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Generate an FMEA, fault tree or other justified representation for a reference design and its changed variant. Compare entities and dependencies with an expert model. Missing probabilities cannot become factual reliability estimates.

requirements.title: Verification activity record
requirements.text: The framework shall retain each EPS or component verification activity with requirement, method, DUT baseline, applicable quantities or observable conditions, inputs, expected response, criterion, evidence variables and status. An inapplicable field shall retain its rationale.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Inspect quantitative analysis/test and qualitative inspection/demonstration fixtures against their method-specific fields. Check the applicable quantity or observable condition, criterion, expected response and evidence. An inapplicable field retains rationale. Missing mandatory fields, failed gates and unresolved criteria remain explicit and prevent an unsupported verdict.

requirements.title: Facility proposal
requirements.text: The framework shall produce a technician-readable verification proposal that specifies conditions, equipment and fixture identities, DUT connections, stimulus sequence, observations and evidence-generation procedure.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: A technician or qualified proxy checks a fixture proposal against a declared completeness checklist and identifies how equipment interacts with the DUT. Facility feasibility remains a separate decision.

requirements.title: Safety declaration
requirements.text: The framework shall include hazards, battery and electronics operating limits, fault-injection envelope, isolation, abort conditions and responsible safety-review status in each proposed physical verification activity.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Use a safe virtual fault fixture and an incomplete physical proposal. Missing limits or approval status block a ready-for-physical-execution label. The framework does not authorize laboratory operations.

requirements.title: Evidence timing
requirements.text: The framework shall record the time base, sampling and synchronization rules and known measurement, calculation and output delays for applied stimuli, responses and telemetry.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Align a known timestamp fixture and expose injected skew and missing timing metadata. Report alignment error or uncertainty against the agreed profile, with no invented global limit.

requirements.title: Telemetry quality
requirements.text: The framework shall check expected telemetry channels, units, timestamps, completeness and sensor validity conditions and preserve raw samples, invalid values and processing masks.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Inject missing samples, inactive sensors and invalid values. Do not treat inactive invalid readings as valid measurements. Match the fixture quality verdict and retained raw data.

requirements.title: Shared software definitions
requirements.text: The framework shall retain revision-linked EPS command, telemetry, event and parameter definitions with identifiers, types, units, ranges and encodings mapped to hardware, functional software and ground dictionaries.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Compare model, flight and ground fixtures against a shared contract. Detect a changed definition in one representation and report every affected mapping.

requirements.title: Flight framework mapping
requirements.text: The framework shall produce or coordinate checked mappings of the EPS software contract to declared cFS software-bus and F-Prime typed-connection profiles and identify behavior and implementation gaps.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Round-trip or validate reference message and port mappings in both profiles. Declare framework version and unsupported exports. Architecture or dictionary generation is distinct from mission-specific functionality.

requirements.title: Command and recovery contract
requirements.text: The framework shall specify and check EPS command preconditions, order, expected effects, rejection and failure behavior, mode transitions and recovery responsibilities across EPS, telemetry, fault-management and safe-mode functions.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Replay nominal, rejected and recovery sequences with a qualified software reference. Confirm functional flow and ownership without claiming deployment of flight software.

requirements.title: Target integration assessment
requirements.text: The framework shall retain a versioned OBC, operating-system, flight-framework and toolchain configuration with compatibility evidence and processor, memory, timing and power budget evidence for EPS functions.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Inspect a build/deployment profile and reference resource records. Distinguish measurements, estimates and unknown target compatibility. Check against mission-supplied allocations when available.

requirements.title: Readable design views
requirements.text: The framework shall produce filtered context, structure, interface and selected-design views from controlled EPS records with identifiers, units, legends and links to the represented baseline.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Compare generated views with a fixture model and apply a declared reviewer task checklist. Assess correctness and readability without proliferating requirement, measure, scenario or state diagrams.

requirements.title: Review package
requirements.text: The framework shall assemble the designated requirement, decision, design, evidence, assumptions, uncertainty, validity limits, findings and dispositions into a baseline-linked review package.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: An independent reviewer locates the designated claims and evidence and records findings and outcomes. Keep author status, reviewer outcome and approval authority distinct.

requirements.title: Minimum adoption and measurement package
requirements.text: The framework shall declare prerequisites, resource footprint, licenses, dependencies and learning instructions for its minimum workflow and record adoption, adaptation, change, reproduction and direct-cost observations under one evaluation protocol.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Demonstrate the minimum workflow from a clean declared environment. Record wall-clock time separately from active person-hours and state the cost period and inclusions. Unknown cost stays unknown.

requirements.title: Contrasting-case reuse
requirements.text: The framework shall apply an identified common core to two predefined contrasting EPS cases using declared parameters, mappings and extensions and retain case outcomes and any core changes.
requirements.proposed_acceptance: Complete the same declared workflow in both cases without undeclared or post hoc core changes. If the core changes, rebaseline and rerun both cases before a reuse claim. No implementation or successful outcome is asserted here.

mission_needs.title: Write and maintain verifiable requirements
mission_needs.text: Enable engineers to learn requirement writing and maintain sourced, verifiable requirements with reusable templates and verification criteria.
mission_needs.mission_requirement: The EPS engineering enterprise shall produce reviewable framework-supported EPS and component requirements whose source, observable quantities or conditions, verification method, criterion, and unresolved decisions are explicit.
mission_needs.moe: Requirement authoring and update effort (person-hours). Report defects found by a qualified reviewer and completeness against the declared requirement record schema.

mission_needs.title: Maintain a consistent evidence chain through changes
mission_needs.text: Keep needs, requirements, design decisions, subsystem allocations, models, software interfaces, and verification evidence consistent as EPS and other subsystem designs change.
mission_needs.mission_requirement: The enterprise shall identify the affected evidence for each designated change and issue a successor baseline with regenerated or explicitly stale evidence and retained discrepancy status.
mission_needs.moe: Correct change turnaround (elapsed hours) and active effort. On a blinded reference set report TP, FP, FN and affected-artifact accuracy against a qualified reviewer. Faster incomplete changes receive no comparative credit.

mission_needs.title: Maintain candidate BOMs and financial estimates
mission_needs.text: Maintain bills of materials and cost estimates across EPS candidate architectures and controlled design changes.
mission_needs.mission_requirement: The enterprise shall obtain a revision-linked BOM and financial estimate for each designated EPS candidate, with sourced prices, quantities, assumptions, uncertainty, and missing cost data visible.
mission_needs.moe: BOM and cost update effort (person-hours). Report differences from a reference BOM and estimate, missing priced items, and estimate uncertainty. This is separate from framework operating cost.

mission_needs.title: Expose early EPS design and interaction problems
mission_needs.text: Assess dynamic mission loads, energy shortages, thermal and EMC concerns, subsystem interactions, component choices, and controller constraints before hardware fabrication.
mission_needs.mission_requirement: The enterprise shall justify designated early EPS decisions using time-dependent mission and component analyses with explicit interface conditions, applicable constraints, and unsupported checks visible.
mission_needs.moe: Coverage of decision-relevant checks and known issues found in reference fixtures. Report analysis turnaround and effort. Physical EPS defect reduction remains an empirical outcome outside framework acceptance.

mission_needs.title: Establish model and policy credibility
mission_needs.text: Use EPS and battery models with documented calibration, validity domains, electrothermal and aging assumptions, uncertainty, and evidence appropriate to the intended decision.
mission_needs.mission_requirement: The enterprise shall distinguish predictions supported within a documented model validity domain from extrapolation and shall distinguish a predicted control-policy benefit from a demonstrated hardware benefit.
mission_needs.moe: Intended decisions covered by applicable model evidence. Report voltage, temperature, energy, health or lifetime residuals in their own units, uncertainty, runtime, and parameter-update delay. Limits require agreement for each intended use.

mission_needs.title: Support RAM requirement coverage and analysis
mission_needs.text: Identify RAM variables in requirements and generate reusable RAM analysis models from the evolving EPS and spacecraft design.
mission_needs.mission_requirement: The enterprise shall relate designated RAM claims to requirements, design failure dependencies, generated analysis models, input assumptions, and verification evidence or explicit gaps.
mission_needs.moe: RAM model preparation effort and coverage of the declared failure and requirement set. Report model generation differences from an expert reference. No framework verdict establishes achieved spacecraft RAM.

mission_needs.title: Prepare feasible, safe and informative verification
mission_needs.text: Define EPS and component verification activities with usable procedures, conditions, equipment and DUT interfaces, safety information, observable variables, and valid synchronized telemetry.
mission_needs.mission_requirement: The enterprise shall provide a reviewable verification proposal and evidence contract for each designated activity, with feasibility and safety decisions reserved to the responsible engineers and testing facility.
mission_needs.moe: Proposal preparation and technician clarification effort. Report missing proposal fields, evidence completeness, invalid samples, and synchronization uncertainty. Physical fault limits and timing tolerances require facility agreement.

mission_needs.title: Engineer consistent EPS flight and ground software integration
mission_needs.text: Keep command, telemetry, event, parameter, mode and recovery definitions consistent with EPS hardware and support cFS and F-Prime mappings and target resource assessment.
mission_needs.mission_requirement: The enterprise shall produce revision-linked EPS software integration contracts, framework-specific mappings, command and mode checks, and processor, memory, timing and power evidence for the declared target configuration.
mission_needs.moe: Interface discrepancy detection and integration effort on common reference fixtures. Report dictionary and behavior coverage, configuration compatibility status, and target resource estimates or measurements. Unverified target deployment stays explicit.

mission_needs.title: Reproduce and reuse evidence for analysis and troubleshooting
mission_needs.text: Enable independent reproduction and reuse of early EPS analysis and later supplied measurements without losing configuration or validity context.
mission_needs.mission_requirement: The enterprise shall permit an independent participant to reconstruct each designated analysis from its controlled baseline and evaluate agreement using result-specific comparison rules fixed before execution.
mission_needs.moe: Successful designated reproductions / attempted designated reproductions, independent active effort, and reconstruction gaps. Agreement limits are result-specific. Reduced use of physical replicas is a future hypothesis.

mission_needs.title: Communicate designs and justification clearly
mission_needs.text: Provide readable design views and requirement-to-design-to-evidence reviews with visible assumptions, limitations, and finding dispositions.
mission_needs.mission_requirement: The enterprise shall provide a controlled review package from which a reviewer can locate the designated design, decision rationale, applicable evidence, and unresolved findings.
mission_needs.moe: Review preparation effort and reviewer task completion, interpretation accuracy, and clarification effort on a fixed task set. Readability needs a reviewer protocol, not an invented visual score.

mission_needs.title: Adopt and reuse the framework within team resources
mission_needs.text: Provide a declared minimum environment, learning path and reusable core suitable for contrasting EPS contexts, with adoption, adaptation and direct operating burdens visible.
mission_needs.mission_requirement: The enterprise shall complete the declared reference workflow in two contrasting EPS cases using an identified common core, declared case adaptations, and independently reconstructable environment instructions.
mission_needs.moe: Adoption and case adaptation effort (active person-hours), direct framework cost (CAD over a declared period), and case completion status. Report required computing, licenses and services. Resource ceilings require stakeholder agreement.

internal_connections.receiving_obligation: Retain source, applicability and tailoring rationale.
Bidirectional registration/retrieval service. Verify semantics and provenance and preserve exact prior content.
Bidirectional domain-change proposals and impact checks. Retain unresolved dependencies and evidence status.
Bidirectional bindings with exact occurrences and source revisions.
Freeze supported scenario/model/coupling/criterion basis and expose missing inputs.
Ordered route: L05 run to L06 adequacy to L07 admissibility to L02 affected-claim status. Each record remains under its domain owner.
Bidirectional contract-test/specification/results. Check both declared profiles, guards/effects/recovery and target constraints.
Preserve raw/processed quality and old/new parameters. Accept updates only through explicit disposition and successor revision.
Bidirectional evidence/review findings. Generate views from exact accepted records and route disposition to the responsible owner.
Publish reviewed knowledge revisions with evidence and reuse limits.

boundary_interfaces.name: Engineering use
boundary_interfaces.validation: Check declared scope, baseline, roles and unresolved criteria.
boundary_interfaces.failure_or_authority_behavior: Engineers retain mission/design/criterion authority. Incomplete records remain unresolved.

boundary_interfaces.name: Source knowledge and components
boundary_interfaces.validation: Preserve source revision, price date/currency, applicability and limits.
boundary_interfaces.failure_or_authority_behavior: Unsupported properties and source claims remain explicit. Registration is not supplier qualification.

boundary_interfaces.name: Discipline execution
actors_or_resources: Declared discipline tools or their operators
boundary_interfaces.validation: Check exact inputs/results, mapping, units, time basis, environment and unsupported checks.
boundary_interfaces.failure_or_authority_behavior: Failure retains logs/raw output and cannot support the corresponding claim. Physical tool placement is open.

boundary_interfaces.name: EPS software engineering
boundary_interfaces.validation: Check both declared mappings, target versions, functional flow and measured/estimated/unknown resources.
boundary_interfaces.failure_or_authority_behavior: Unsupported exports, behavior and target compatibility remain gaps. Mission software is an engineered artifact.

boundary_interfaces.name: Facility planning and supplied evidence
boundary_interfaces.validation: Check DUT/equipment/calibration/clock mapping, raw quality, operating/fault limits and responsible approval status.
boundary_interfaces.failure_or_authority_behavior: Missing safety data blocks physical-readiness status. Facility authorization and physical execution remain external.

boundary_interfaces.name: Independent review and evaluation
boundary_interfaces.validation: Check designated task/baseline, protocol, reference answers, comparison rules and measured versus unknown status.
boundary_interfaces.failure_or_authority_behavior: Review outcome and study/project-deliverable assessment retain distinct authorities. Replay failures remain visible.

functions.name: Guide a user and tailor a controlled case
Specify and revise needs, requirements, criteria and design dependencies
Characterize and compare EPS options with BOM, cost, RAM and resource evidence
Execute and reproduce analyses with declared model applicability
Define, map and check shared EPS service contracts
Specify verification and assess safe later-execution readiness
Control evidence, change impact and new observation reconciliation
Communicate justification and return reviewed learning

scenario_realizations.summary: Guided tailoring and option preparation followed by common-basis scoped evidence and engineer review.
Cross-domain impact and contract revisions followed by reanalysis, evidence assessment and successor disposition.
Failed-gate evidence interpretation and identified updates followed by safe later-test specification.
scenario_realizations.control: Physical handoff requires external facility authorization.

rationale_sources.claim: Implementation independent responsibilities, interactions, stores and later physical allocation.
Tailoring, shared interfaces, coordinated requirements/verification planning and cost assumptions.
Mission sizing, component choices, early thermal/EMC and protection/telemetry verification mechanisms.
Hardware/software regrouping and bounded architecture generation with separate mission behavior and dictionaries.
Calibration, invalid telemetry, timing, degradation and sensor error affect model-based assessment.
Hardware interaction fidelity/runtime/delay are platform and profile specific.

limitations: No operational performance or achieved EPS RAM is established.
Numerical criteria, prediction-error and timing limits remain intended-use/profile specific.
No products, nodes, physical winner or new searches are introduced.
